description: $0.005 USDC on Solana per snapshot - the payment buys one signed aggregate snapshot of our own front door for the one catalogue id and window you name: the counts computed by the published counting rule, the window bounds, the threshold applied, and the scope label ('our doorway only'). Counts only - no client identity, no per-client rows. Below-threshold snapshots answer NOT-OFFERED with the count never printed.

catalogue_id.description: One catalogue id from GET /catalogue (e.g. discovery-total).

window.description: UTC-day window, inclusive: { start: YYYY-MM-DD, end: YYYY-MM-DD }, max 366 days.

name: observatory_snapshot
